stories.title: Engineered bacteria map sialic acid availability in inflamed gut
stories.takeaway: Local microbial nutrient exposure differs from bulk measurements.
stories.what_happened: A bacterial reporter mapped sialic acid in mouse inflammation models and revealed spatial separation between peak sensing and injury.
stories.why_it_matters: Spatial biosensors could improve studies of host–microbe metabolism.
stories.caveat: Mouse models; human validation is needed.

stories.title: Inflammatory signaling alters pediatric Crohn’s organoid metabolism
stories.takeaway: Cytokine stimulation can change epithelial energy metabolism.
stories.what_happened: Ten donor-derived ileal organoid lines were examined using biochemical assays, imaging and LC-MS; cytokine exposure increased GLUT1 protein while reducing ATP.
stories.why_it_matters: Human epithelial models help isolate metabolic responses to inflammation.
stories.caveat: Small donor cohort and in vitro exposure constrain generalization.

stories.title: Scoping review of microbiome research with intestinal organoids
stories.takeaway: Organoid co-cultures enable mechanistic investigation of microbial effects.
stories.what_happened: The review surveys organoid and chip approaches for epithelial regeneration, barrier function and microbial interactions.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful orientation for selecting intestinal disease models.
stories.caveat: Scoping review, not a quantitative comparison of platform performance.

stories.title: AI-guided design of brain organoid matrices
stories.takeaway: Defined hydrogels could improve control of tissue-specific cues.
stories.what_happened: A review proposes computational optimization of scaffold mechanics, transport and biochemical signaling using iterative experimental feedback.
stories.why_it_matters: The design framework is relevant to reproducible engineered tissue systems.
stories.caveat: A proposed framework does not establish superiority of AI-designed scaffolds.

stories.title: Multimodal profiling for organoid characterization
stories.takeaway: Combining molecular and functional measurements may better establish model fidelity.
stories.what_happened: A review organizes emerging organoid profiling technologies and discusses integration of genomic, molecular and physiological measurements.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful for designing characterization and validation strategies for advanced tissue models.
stories.caveat: Review published Nov 11; integration and standardization remain unresolved.
